title: Garmin Multisport Activity Distance Leaderboard
dataSources: TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), Garmin multisport activities (`garmin:multisport`), TriDot plans (`tridot:plan`), brick workouts (`brick:workout`), and transition logs (`transition:log`).
app: TrainingPeaks structured workouts, Garmin multisport FIT exports, TriDot training plans, brick workout logs, and transition timing notes ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=garmin:multisport distance_km=*
| stats sum(distance_km) as total_value, avg(distance_km) as avg_value by activity_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks activity type values by total and average distance across Garmin multisport activity events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `distance_km` values for each Garmin multisport activity event and review total and average distance by activity type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total distance.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which activity type shows the biggest distance numbers in your Garmin multisport activity data.
